caption:
Paused until they are back

The other one leaves the room, so Cella pauses the show. When they sit back down, she presses play again.

For whoever pauses it until the other one is back.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A lavender room. Two small block figures with white eyes, one ink-black and one plum, sit on a sofa on the left looking at a dark screen on the right where a yellow ball rolls. The plum figure stands up and walks out of the frame to the right, and a white pause mark appears on the screen with the ball stopped. The black figure waits. The plum figure walks back in and sits down, its eyes close in a smile and it pulses, the pause mark goes away and the ball rolls on. The text stays: 1 pause, until they are back. The last card: for whoever pauses it until the other one is back, Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella paused it until you were back. Somebody pressed play together.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-dic-s4, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168 (3-ene). (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 14 seguidores y la semana de fiestas no separa causa de temporada: lectura de orden de magnitud.
